title: Start a new game night tradition with these Black Friday board game deals
summary: As of Nov. 25, shop these Black Friday board game deals.
content: The best Black Friday board game deals Best deception game deal Chameleon $17.49 (Save $7.48) Get Deal Best Strategy Board Game Deal Catan $24.98 (Save $25.01) Get Deal Best Kids' Board Game Deal Mouse Trap $19.99 (Save $5) Get Deal Best Dungeons & Dragons Deal Dungeons & Dragons - Starter Set: Heroes of the Borderlands $39.99 (Save $10.00) Get Deal Best cooperative board game Horrified: American Monsters $27.99 (save $12) Get Deal Looking to start up a board game night tradition? Well, Black Friday week is the perfect time to host the inaugural event, with price drops across all kinds of games — from family games to hardcore strategy brain-teasers — in Amazon's Black Friday sale . A board game isn't just the perfect thing to add to your arsenal of entertainment items at home. It's also a good gift idea for a hard-to-shop-for relative, older kids, or family who just doesn't want or need anything else — not to mention the potential for lots of fun with family and friends over Thanksgiving and Christmas. Board games — or "table top gaming", to give it a proper name — is having a moment, which means there are lots of new and innovative titles available. There are twists on classics as well as ingenious new concepts. Don't worry if you're a bit lost in the gaming world, when it comes to board games we know our stuff, and we've combed the Black Friday listings to find you the best discounted games. Here are the best Black Friday board game deals we've found so far. Keep checking back, however, as new deals will be added as Black Friday week rolls on. Best Black Friday deception board game deal Opens in a new window Credit: Big Potato Chameleon $17.49 at Amazon $24.97 Save $7.48 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it There's a current trend for deception games, partly driven by the popularity of TV's The Traitors . Chameleon sees a group of players take turn to describe a word or concept without actually saying it. But one player is actually the Chameleon and has to guess the word from the other players' clues — all while avoiding detection. It's a ridiculous amount of fun, and perfect for big groups and players of all ages. Best Black Friday strategy board game deal Opens in a new window Credit: Amazon Catan $39.99 at Amazon $49.99 Save $10 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Catan is a veritable board game classic, and it's a great pick to snag while it's discounted. Three to four players settle a randomly laid-out island, collecting wood, brick, wool, grain, and ore to build roads, settlements, and cities. Games wrap up in about an hour to 90 minutes, and it's fairly easy to learn. And if you're tired of playing the same things over and over, Catan's modular board means no two games set up the same way. It's a significant upgrade from Monopoly that's suitable for the whole family. Best Black Friday kids' board game deal Opens in a new window Credit: MB Games Mouse Trap $19.99 at Amazon Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it The classics are classic for a reason. Mouse Trap has delighted kids and families for years, and nothing has changed after all this time. Indeed, it's as fiddly to set up as it ever was, but there's no denying the fun of setting the trap in motion. Kids will love the mechanics, parents will love the nostalgia. You can also find Black Friday discounts on other kids classics, including Connect 4 , Battleship , and Candy Land . Best Black Friday Dungeons & Dragons deal Opens in a new window Credit: Amazon Dungeons & Dragons - Starter Set: Heroes of the Borderlands $39.95 at Amazon $49.99 Save $10.04 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it If you've ever wanted to get started with Dungeons & Dragons but didn't know how, this board game is the perfect introduction. It has a quick-start guide, player boards for the Cleric, Rogue, Wizard, and Fighter, and cards for species, backgrounds, spells, and gear so nobody has to build a character from scratch. Three to five players run through three adventure booklets split between combat, exploration, and roleplaying, and the poster maps for the Keep and the Caves of Chaos pull from one of the oldest modules in the game’s history. It's got everything beginners need and then some, so it's a much less daunting introductory experience. Best Black Friday cooperative board game deal Opens in a new window Credit: Ravensburger Horrified: American Monsters $27.99 at Amazon $39.99 Save $12.00 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it If you haven't played the Horrified series, it's worth checking out for team-based beast-slaying. Players join forces to take on various classic monster — in this version it's American monsters that include Bigfoot, the Jersey Devil, and Mothman — with different ways of killing each monster. Board game fans will be familiar with the mechanics of the gameplay but the great thing about it is that you can mix and match the monsters, so each time you play is different. It can also get pretty tense as you ratchet up the difficulty level. title: The best Black Friday PlayStation deals: PS5 games, cheap controllers, headsets, and more
summary: Shop Black Friday PlayStation deals on PS5 and PS4 games, controllers, and accessories, plus what to know before buying a console.
content: The best Black Friday PlayStation deals: Best PlayStation controller deal PlayStation DualSense Wireless Controller (Chroma Pearl) $59.88 (save $20.11) Get Deal Best PlayStation game deal Marvel's Spider Man 2 (PS5, Standard Edition) $28.19 (save $41.80) Get Deal Best PlayStation accessory deal PlayStation Portal + Charging Case $299.98 (save $22.99) Get Deal Black Friday is finally here, and that means deals on PlayStation games, accessories, and more are live at Amazon and plenty of other major retailers. With the debut of Grand Theft Auto VI and a slew of other great titles available right now, it's a good time to pick up a spare controller, a headset, or a few titles you've been waiting on. Shopping now also puts you ahead of the holiday rush, with a better shot at finding what you want in stock and getting it delivered in time for gift giving. Many of these prices are set to last through the weekend and into Cyber Monday, though popular items can sell out before then, especially with the demand for accessories and consoles in general to play the biggest game release of the year (and potentially all time.) SEE ALSO: PS5 and PS5 Pro Black Friday deals 2026: What to realistically expect If you’re shopping for a PS5 console , you're going to run into a bit more difficulty when it comes to availability and sales. We haven't seen any deals worth mentioning just yet, but we're keeping an eye out. Why PS5 consoles are hard to find this Black Friday If you're looking to buy a PS5 this year, you'll be hard-pressed to find one. Grand Theft Auto VI just arrived on Nov. 19, and PS5 demand has spiked ever since. Sony calls the game the biggest launch in PlayStation history and says more new PS5 consoles came online in one day than ever before. Amazon and PlayStation Direct are currently out of stock of most PS5 consoles in the US, and other big retailers are in the same position, so your best chance at a console is a local store that still has a few on the shelf, though you can still find a few stragglers here and there if you're searching. Demand was already climbing before the game came out. Sony has no real hardware promotions for Black Friday this year, so the savings are on controllers, headsets, games, and other accessories. If you're going to need a console to play the biggest game of the year, you're going to have to cough up the retail price or higher right now, unless you go second-hand. Best PlayStation controller deal PlayStation DualSense Wireless Controller (Chroma Pearl) $59.88 at Amazon $79.99 Save $20.11 Get Deal at Amazon Get Deal at Amazon Get Deal at Walmart Why we like it Whether you’re checking off your gift list or shopping for yourself, buying another controller is almost always a good idea. If the battery dies mid-game, you can swap controllers and charge the other. Plus, there are tons of different colors to collect if that interests you. This model has haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, a built-in microphone, and a headset jack, so it's everything you need to get started playing. It’s a physical copy, though, so check which PS5 you’re buying it for as you'll need a disc drive to play. The majority of our favorite streamers bumped up the costs of subscriptions this year, including Peacock, Apple TV , Disney+ , Hulu, Netflix , ESPN, and Paramount+ . Viewers everywhere are looking for the chance to save some money, so the slate of Black Friday streaming deals has arrived in the nick of time. As Mashable's resident streaming expert, I've been tracking streaming prices for years now. There's absolutely no doubt that Black Friday is the best time of year to sign up and save on that wallet strain. I'm pumped that despite all of the price hikes in 2026, it's proving to be another banger year for streaming deals. I highly recommend taking advantage of these prices while they're available, particularly if you're looking to diversify your viewing and try out a new platform. The truth is that we're unlikely to see discounts this steep for a while. Most streaming deals for major streaming services went live early during Black Friday week, but I'll certainly be keeping an eye out for any more that roll in. Most deals expire on Nov. 30, aka Cyber Monday, unless otherwise noted. So don't hesitate to secure the offer ASAP. Below, find my top picks for the best Black Friday streaming deals of 2026. Psst. Another thing to note is that most Black Friday streaming deals are limited to new and returning subscribers (meaning you haven't been a subscriber for at least a month). In most cases, you can't just cancel then re-subscribe at a lower rate, unfortunately. This year, you can secure an entire year of streaming for half the usual cost. That drops it to just $5.49 per month, or $65.88 total for the year. Better yet, the offer is available as a standalone deal , a Prime Video add-on , or a Roku subscription . Yes, you'll have to watch with ads, but for the price, it's easy to look past that. With a Basic subscription, you also won't get access to live sports. Everything else is yours to enjoy — including recent box office gems like Backrooms , Wuthering Heights , and The Drama , as well as HBO Max's many excellent original series like The Pitt , The Comeback , A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms, and Industry. Best ad-free streaming deal Opens in a new window Credit: Paramount+ Paramount+ $2.99/month for two months (save $22) Get Deal Why we like it This year's Paramount Plus Black Friday deal is exactly the same as last year's. That's not necessarily a bad thing, though, as it's one of the only streamers to offer a deal on its ad-free tier. You can get two months of either Paramount+ Essential or Premium for just $2.99 per month (available as both a standalone deal and an add-on ). In other words, there's really no reason to not go with Paramount+ Premium. You save almost 80% compared to just 67% by going with Premium, and you get to enjoy your content ad-free. Not to mention, with a Premium subscription, you'll also unlock access to Showtime in its entirety, as well as your local CBS channel live. It's a no-brainer. Best Prime Video add-on streaming deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple TV Apple TV (Prime Video add-on) $6.99/month for 6 months (save $8/month) Get Deal Why we like it Now that Apple TV costs a ridiculous $14.99 per month , it's harder to justify signing up for your own subscription. Thankfully, for Black Friday , the Apple TV Prime Video add-on and Roku subscription are both down to just $6.99 per month for six months. That's more than half off its usual cost, saving you a total of $48 over the promotional period. You'll have to either be a Prime member or a Roku subscriber to secure the discount. Apple TV's outstanding library is well worth the subscription, even if you cancel after the six-month promotional period. It's stacked with Emmy-winning TV series like Widow's Bay , Pluribus , and Severance , as well as Oscar-winning and nominated films, including Coda , F1: The Movie , and Killers of the Flower Moon. Best Black Friday bundle deal Opens in a new window Credit: Hulu / Disney+ Disney+ and Hulu Premium (ad-free) $14.99/month for 12 months (save $7/month) Get Deal Why we like it Disney has shockingly revived the exact same Black Friday bundle deals for Disney and Hulu from last year, despite raising prices across the board earlier this fall. If you're looking for the most bang for your buck and prefer to watch without ads, you can get an entire year of both Disney+ and Hulu Premium for only $14.99 per month. Considering an ad-free standalone Disney+ Premium plan typically costs $21.49 per month, the typical bundle price of $21.99 on a normal day is already an excellent deal. But this knocks an extra $7 off, getting you both streamers for less than the cost of one. You can also opt for the ad-supported plan and get both Disney+ and Hulu Basic for only $4.99 per month for a year, which is an even steeper discount. A Disney+ and Hulu bundle subscription is your ticket to the Super Bowl this season, as well as select live ESPN College Football games, the entire Skywalker Saga and most of the Marvel Cinematic Universe , new releases like Toy Story 5 , Hulu and Disney+ Originals, hit ABC TV shows, and so much more. Plus, you'll lock in a full year at a fixed cost, bypassing any potential increases once the upcoming merger goes live. Best budget deal Opens in a new window Credit: Peacock Peacock Select $29.99 for 1 year (save $60) Get Deal Why we like it Normally I wouldn't recommend Peacock's Select tier, as it's extremely limited in scope and not worth it for the usual cost. However, with this Peacock Black Friday deal, it's definitely worth a second look. At $29.99 for one year, which breaks down to about $2.50 per month, you'll get access to all of your TV favorites from NBC, Bravo, and more. It doesn't include Peacock Originals, hit movies, or live sports — in order to unlock access to those, you'll need at least the Premium tier. Fortunately, that tier is also included in the Peacock Black Friday offer. You can get Premium for $89.99 for one year, which saves you $40. Although, we'll also keep updating this guide as more offers go live throughout the whole BF weekend, so be sure to keep this guide bookmarked for the latest discounts. Best Pokémon TCG deal: 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collection Opens in a new window Credit: The Pokémon Company Pokémon TCG: 30th Celebration Tech Sticker Collection $39.95 at Amazon $49.99 Save $10.04 Shop Now at Amazon With the popular 30th Celebration Booster Bundle now out of stock, the Tech Sticker Collection is the next best way to grab affordable packs from the Pokémon TCG's anniversary expansion on Black Friday — now as low as $39.95 at Amazon with a whole 20% off, or $10.04 off its current $49.99 list price. For that money, you’re getting three 30th Celebration booster packs, a foil promo card featuring either Lucario or Alolan Exeggutor, and a matching sticker sheet. You’re not only paying $13.32 per pack before counting the extra collectibles, you’re also only paying $6.24 above the Tech Sticker Collection’s $33.24 market price on TCGplayer . With that $43.05 price cut off the current typical price of $147.95, you’re only paying $3.50 per pack — and only $5.99 above TCGplayer’s estimated $98.91 market price . The lowest price Amazon has ever seen for this box (confirmed with Mashable’s price tracking methods), we don’t expect this deal to last very long in particular. Each booster contains 14 cards, including a traditional foil and one to four rare-or-higher cards, with the chance to pull special borderless variants featuring Marvel favourites like Iron Man, Hulk, and Doctor Doom. This box is even shipped and sold directly by Amazon rather than a third-party seller, although the listing is marked as a final sale. That’s actually the lowest price this newly released box has ever been. If you’re a fan of the original anime series, this is a must-buy for grabbing revamped versions of classic cards, like Dark Magician and Elemental Hero Flamewingman. You get three five-card packs of Ultra Rares and three additional Secret Rares, each with a chance to upgrade to Starlight Rare. There are 18 reimagined anime cards to collect altogether. title: Black Friday 2026: Opening times for Walmart, Target, Best Buy, Costco, and more
summary: Shopping in stores for Black Friday 2026? See which major retailers are closed on Thanksgiving Day and what time Target, Best Buy, Walmart, and more open on Nov. 27.
content: We're closing in on the biggest shopping day of the year. While most people will do the bulk of their shopping online for Black Friday 2026 , some still prefer the in-store experience. There's something nostalgic about heading to a big box store at the crack of dawn to do some discount shopping. SEE ALSO: We found 163 Black Friday deals we're actually excited about: Save 50% on Amazon devices, OLED TVs, and noise-cancelling headphones If you're gearing up for that classic Black Friday in-store shopping experience, knowing when retailers close for Thanksgiving and reopen the next morning is key to planning your route. Nearly all major big-box and department stores will keep their doors locked on Thanksgiving Day (Thursday, Nov. 26), though their websites and apps will be running Black Friday deals all day long. We've rounded up both Thanksgiving and Black Friday 2026 store hours for major retailers in alphabetical order below — just be sure to double-check your local store's hours before heading out, as mall and regional schedules can vary. Black Friday store hours Apple Store Thanksgiving 2026: Closed, but you can browse the best Apple Black Friday deals online and in the Apple Store app. Black Friday 2026: Open hours vary by location (typically the mall's or street's regular hours). Black Friday 2026 live blog : Top deals, store hours, and real-time updates Best Buy Thanksgiving 2026: Closed, though you can shop online during its 24-hour Thanksgiving Flash Sale. Black Friday 2026: Opens at 6 a.m. local time, closes at 10 p.m. local time. Feel free to camp out like old times if you're hoping to score a high-demand item. Just note that Best Buy may employ a ticketing system "for the safety and security of customers and employees." Want a game plan before heading out? Check out our full guide covering everything to know about Best Buy's Black Friday sale , from doorbusters to ad highlights. Costco Thanksgiving 2026: Warehouses are closed for the holiday, while active members ($65/year and up) can shop discounts on Beats headphones, robot vacuums, and outdoor gear online in our roundup of best Costco Black Friday deals . Black Friday 2026: Regular warehouse hours — opens at 9 a.m. for Executive members and 10 a.m. for all other members. CVS Thanksgiving 2026: Most locations are open with regular or reduced holiday hours (pharmacy hours vary, so check your local store before heading out). Black Friday 2026: Opens at 7 a.m. local time, closes at 10 p.m. at most locations (24-hour stores maintain regular schedules). Kohl's Thanksgiving 2026: Closed, but Kohl's main sale is already running online — browse the best Kohl's Black Friday deals from your couch instead. Black Friday 2026: Opens at 5 a.m. local time, closes at midnight at most locations. On Black Friday, the first 200 shoppers at every Kohl's store can receive $5 to $100 in instant Kohl's Cash. On Saturday, Nov. 28, the first 200 shoppers will receive an instant Sephora at Kohl's promotional gift, valued at $5 to $100, to use that day. Show up early if you are a free MyLowe's Rewards member: the first 50 members in line at 6 a.m. get a free Black Friday Mystery Bucket (with a chance at grand prizes up to $2,000), while the next 100 score a Golden Mini Bucket and $5 in MyLowe's Money. When you shop in Macy's stores on Friday, Nov. 27 and Saturday, Nov. 28, you can receive a free reusable tote bag with any $100+ purchase. Totes are limited to one per customer while supplies last. Sephora Thanksgiving 2026: Closed, while Cyber Week brand deals run online all day ahead of Sephora's main Black Friday kickoff at 6 p.m. PT — browse our Sephora beauty tech deal roundup for markdowns on Shark stylers, LED face masks, and more. title: Moon phase today: What the Moon will look like on November 27, 2026
summary: See the Moon phase expected for November 27, 2026 as well as when the next Full Moon is expected.
content: It's been a few nights since the Full Moon, and we're starting to see a little less of it illuminated. The Moon is still in its Waning Gibbous phase, with the bright portion gradually getting smaller each night as we head towards the Third Quarter. What is today's Moon phase? As of Friday, Nov. 27, the NASA's Daily Moon Guide tracker tells us the Moon is in the Waning Gibbous phase, with 90% of its surface visible. If you don't have any visual aids, you can still see the Mares Serenitatis, Kepler Crater, as well as the Tycho Crater. With binoculars, you'll also see the Gassendi Crater, the Clavius Crater, and the Apennine Mountains. And if you have a telescope, you'll get to see all this plus the Apollo 11 and 14, and 16 landing spots. When is the next Full Moon? In North America, the next Full Moon will take place on December 23. In other time zones it will fall on December 24. What are Moon phases? It takes around 29.5 days for the Moon to move through all its phases, according to NASA . Throughout this period, the Moon's position relative to Earth and the Sun determines how much of its illuminated surface we can see. Starting with a New Moon, the visible portion gradually increases until it reaches a Full Moon, before shrinking again as the cycle comes back around. The eight phases are: New Moon - The Moon is between Earth and the sun, so the side we see is dark (in other words, it's invisible to the eye). Waxing Crescent - A small sliver of light appears on the right side (Northern Hemisphere). First Quarter - Half of the Moon is lit on the right side. It looks like a half-Moon. Waxing Gibbous - More than half is lit up, but it's not quite full yet. Full Moon - The whole face of the Moon is illuminated and fully visible. Waning Gibbous - The Moon starts losing light on the right side. (Northern Hemisphere) Third Quarter (or Last Quarter) - Another half-Moon, but now the left side is lit. Waning Crescent - A thin sliver of light remains on the left side before going dark again.

If there's an Amazon device on your list, there are some massive discounts live on Fire TV Sticks, Kindles , Echo devices, and Alexa tablets. Since many of these devices saw price increases in 2026 (thanks, RAMageddon ), we weren't expecting much. But I'm pleased to say that so far, many of these deals are surpassing expectations — particularly on the brand-new Echo devices. Best Black Friday Fire TV Stick deal Opens in a new window Credit: Amazon Amazon Fire TV Stick 4K $19.99 at Amazon $59.99 Save $40 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Sadly, the entire Fire TV Stick lineup was hit with a price increase back in August. But that doesn't seem to affect how impressive the discounts are. Prime members can grab the brand-new Fire TV Stick 4K, which was released in September, for just $19.99. That's its best price so far on record. The 4K Select was only released last year, but the 4K has officially replaced it . It features the Vega 2.0 operating system for even speedier navigation and a more robust app store. Amazon listened to customer qualms with the 4K Select and added over 2,000 more apps to the 4K, including Spotify, Xbox, VLC, and a range of VPNs. content: The best Black Friday Apple deals: Best AirPods Deal Apple AirPods Pro 3 $149 (save $100) Get Deal Best MacBook Deal Apple MacBook Air, 13-inch (M5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) $999.99 (save $299.01) Get Deal Best MacBook Neo deal MacBook Neo, 13-inch (A18 Pro, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD) $599 (save $100) Get Deal Best iPad Deal Apple iPad Mini (A17 Pro, 128GB, WiFi) $499 (save $100) Get Deal Best Apple Watch Deal Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS, 42mm) $299 (save $100) Get Deal Apple raised its prices this year, but who didn't? It's something we've seen across the board with tech . That's why we're all grateful for Black Friday , which is here once again. This is your best chance to dodge the price hikes and land a tech bargain , so we're committed to paying extra close attention to the best Black Friday Apple deals. Yes, Apple does do Black Friday, but not in the way you might expect. Shopping directly on Apple's website usually means getting a gift card for future purchases. That's not quite what most shoppers are seeking. To get the real deals, you need to look at retailers such as Amazon , Walmart , Best Buy , and Target . These retailers duke it out to see who can offer the best prices on AirPods, MacBooks, and iPads. Walmart and Amazon are famous for outdoing each other by a single cent. Which is fine by us. Usually, prices on Apple products drop to record lows during the hectic Black Friday weekend. However, especially good deals can also sell out quickly. In years past, Mashable's team spotted many a record low on AirPods only for them to sell out before we could finish writing a 200-word story about it. SEE ALSO: Black Friday 2026 live: Top deals, store hours, and real-time updates Best Buy, Amazon, and Target's official Black Friday sales all technically started well before Black Friday proper on Nov. 27, and Apple prices are showing it. The AirPods Pro 3 have dropped to a record low of $149, the Apple Watch Series 12 is now $100 off, and the 13-inch MacBook Air is finally back below $1,000 again. Best Black Friday AirPods deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple AirPods Pro 3 $149 at Amazon $249 Save $100 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it We were hoping our favorite AirPods would return to their record-low pricing of $169. Our expectations? Met and surpassed, as our favorite AirPods dropped down to $149, marking a new record-low price by a margin of $20. All told, that cuts an impressive $100 off their $249 list price (a total discount of 40%). Barring any freak price drops (never say never), this will be the absolute best price you can get for these earbuds that come with excellent noise-cancellation , great battery life at eight hours per charge, impressive balanced sound, and a built-in heart rate monitor. Check out our full review of the Apple AirPods Pro 3. More AirPods deals Apple AirPods 4 $89 (save $40) Get Deal Apple AirPods Max 2 $419 (save $130) Get Deal Black Friday AirPods deals to watch The AirPods 5 haven't received a proper discount yet, as Apple's newest AirPods . The version without a wireless charging case got a few dollars off the $129 price around its release, while the $149 wireless charging case edition hasn't had any price drops. If these buds are going on sale in 2026, Black Friday is likely when. Best MacBook deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple MacBook Air, 13-inch (M5, 16GB RAM, 512GB RAM) $999.99 at Amazon $1,299 Save $299.01 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it This is only the second time the 13-inch MacBook Air has fallen below $999.99 since its summer price hike (and the first time was earlier this week). According to our laptop expert, this is a great laptop for college students because of its size and zippy M5 power — and it's also an overall daily driver that will more than suit most folks' needs. If you prefer a slightly larger display, the 15-inch Air with the same specs is $300 off at the time of writing. Check out our full review of the Apple MacBook Air (M5). More MacBook deals Apple MacBook Neo (A18 Pro, 8GB RAM, 256GB SSD) $599 (save $100) Get Deal Apple MacBook Air, 13-inch (M5, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD) $1,199 (save $400) Get Deal Apple MacBook Air, 15-inch (M5, 16GB RAM, 512GB SSD) $1,199 (save $300) Get Deal Apple MacBook Air, 15-inch (M5, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD) $1,399 (save $400) Get Deal Apple MacBook Air, 13-inch (M5, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD) $1,399 (save $400) Get Deal Apple MacBook Pro, 14-inch (M6, 16GB RAM, 1TB SSD) $1,799 (save $200) Get Deal Apple MacBook Pro, 16-inch (M5, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD) $2,699 (save $300) Get Deal Apple MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR display, 16-inch (M5 Pro, 24GB RAM, 1TB SSD) $3,200 (save $199) Get Deal Best Mac mini deal Apple Mac Mini (M6) $779 at Amazon $899 Save $120 Get Deal at Amazon Get Deal at Best Buy Get Deal at Apple.com Why we like it The M6 Mac mini is on sale for $779 at Amazon, down from $899. That's $120 in savings on the model with 16GB of memory and 256GB of storage. If you already have a monitor, keyboard, and mouse, it's worth a look — just keep in mind that none of those come in the box. Our sister site PCMag gave the M6 Mac mini an Editors' Choice award, praising its performance, compact design, and ability to stay cool and quiet. It measures just five inches across, but still has room for two front-facing USB-C ports, three Thunderbolt 4 ports, and an HDMI connection, with support for up to three displays. Black Friday MacBook deals to watch MacBook prices went up in June of this year, with the Neo jumping by $100 and the Air by $200. That means it's highly unlikely we'll see prices reach their former record lows, even if they start at a much higher price point. I've taken this into account as I select the best deals and note the deals to look out for. Best iPad deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple iPad mini (A17 Pro, 128GB, WiFi) $499 at Amazon $599 Save $100 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Mashable considers the iPad mini the best iPad for entertainment , making it a strong contender for the best Apple tablet for many shoppers. The up-to-date 2026 version isn't cheap at full price. In fact, Mashable Tech and Shopping Editor Timothy Werth wrote in his review of the tiny tablet, "A slightly cheaper iPad Mini priced around $499 or $599 would make a lot more sense to me, and be much easier to recommend." Luckily, with this $100 off the 2024 edition on Black Friday, the iPad mini is available for exactly that price. The Liquid Retina display is fantastic, as is the zippy performance from the A17 Pro chip. And of course, you can't beat the portability. Check out our full review of the Apple iPad mini. More iPad deals Apple iPad (A16, 128GB, WiFi) $379 (save $70) Get Deal Apple iPad Air, 11-inch (M4, 128GB, WiFi) $649 (save $100) Get Deal Apple iPad Air, 13-inch (M4, 128GB, WiFi) $849 (save $100) Get Deal Apple iPad Pro, 11-inch (M5, 256GB, WiFi) $1,049 (save $150) Get Deal Apple iPad mini (A17 Pro, 128GB, WiFi) $499 (save $100) Get Deal Black Friday iPad deals to watch The 11-inch iPad Pro is technically on sale, but a $100 price drop on a $1,200 iPad isn't significant. It is the lowest price this tablet has dropped to in the past five months. Still, a $200 price drop would make this a more tempting buy. Best Apple Watch deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS, 42mm) $299 at Amazon $399 Save $100 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it The Apple Watch Series 12 was announced just this past September, and we saw it drop to $349.99 once. Then, for early Black Friday sales, it got down to $329. We hoped for more, and we were rewarded with a price drop to $299 the week of Black Friday. With RAMaggedon driving prices up, we're thrilled to see this discount so early on in the Series 12 time on the market. More Apple Watch deals Apple Watch SE 3 (GPS, 40mm) $179 (save $20) Get Deal Apple Watch SE 3 (GPS, 44mm) $209 (save $70) Get Deal Apple Watch SE 3 (GPS + Cellular, 40mm) $229 (save $70) Get Deal Apple Watch SE 3 (GPS + Cellular, 44mm) $259 (save $70) Get Deal Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS, 46mm) $349 (save $100) Get Deal Apple Watch Ultra 3 (GPS + cellular, 49mm) $549 (save $250) Get Deal Apple Watch Ultra 4 (GPS + Cellular, 49mm) $649.99 (save $149.01) Get Deal More Black Friday Apple Watch deals Apple Watch Ultra 3 — $549 $799 (save $250) How we chose the best Apple deals Let's start with the very expensive elephant in the room. In June, Apple raised prices on MacBooks, Macs, iPads, the HomePod, Apple TVs, and even the Vision Pro headset, followed by iPhone price increases in September. With some prices rising by $200 or more, the likelihood of them falling to record lows is low. Instead, we research the market to identify products that have been at or near record lows over the past five months. We also took into account the frequency of deals. If, like the AirPods Pro 3, there's a $50 deal that's nearly always on, we don't necessarily consider that a deal worth highlighting. On the other hand, if an iPad is $100 off for the first time in a month, we'll include it and note its pricing history. Finally, we considered our reviewers' first-hand experiences with these products. Most of the items in this guide have been hands-on tested by at least one person on the Mashable staff. Our team also prioritized Mashable award winners, choosing the best deals based on overall product performance and value. Still looking for more Black Friday deals? title: Black Friday Apple Watch deals are live, and theyre actually good: Prices start at just $179
summary: Black Friday Apple Watch deals have landed, and they're surprisingly good this year. Get the Apple Watch SE 3 for just $179, or save $100 on the new Series 12.
content: The best Black Friday Apple Watch deals: Best Apple Watch deal overall Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS, 42mm) $299 (save $100 at Amazon) Get Deal Best budget Apple watch deal Apple Watch SE 3 (GPS, 40mm) $179 (save $70 at Amazon) Get Deal Best Apple Watch Ultra Deal Apple Watch Ultra 4 (49mm, GPS + Cellular) $649.99 (save $149.01 at Amazon) Get Deal Best Previous-Gen Deal Apple Watch Ultra 3 (49mm, GPS + Cellular) $549 (save $250 at Best Buy) Get Deal Black Friday sales are in full swing, and new deals are popping up every day. If you're in the market for a new Apple Watch, now's the time to get some serious shopping done: Every single Apple Watch model is now on sale for a record-low price . As of this writing, prices start at a mere $179 for the budget-friendly Apple Watch SE 3. Released in September 2025, the SE 3 added an always-on display while also maintaining its 18-hour battery life, meaning you don't have to make many compromises at all. And if you would like to upgrade to a wearable with more advanced health and fitness features, this fall's new Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4 models are also heavily discounted. For Black Friday 2026 , our shopping reporters are closely monitoring prices at all the major retailers to make sure Mashable readers always know where to find the lowest-possible prices on Apple products, so keep checking back as we spot new Black Friday deals on Apple products . We'll get through this stressful holiday season together. Best Apple Watch deal overall Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple Watch Series 12 (GPS, 42mm) $299 at Amazon $399 Save $100 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Mashable recently named the Apple Watch Series 12 a Gift of the Year winner , and it's going to be at the top of many people's holiday wish lists. The Series 12 has all-new electrical and optical sensors that can take almost-live heart rate readings, giving you even more data for the revamped Vitals app. It also supports a new "Readiness" score that's useful for athletes with varied workout routines, according to our reviewer, and it charges faster than before. As of this writing, the Series 12 is down to a record-low price of $299 at Amazon and Walmart ( Target lists it at $299.99) — a 25% savings. We do not expect that price to get any lower. Read Mashable's full review of the Apple Watch Series 12. Best budget Apple Watch deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple Watch SE 3 (GPS, 40mm) $179 at Apple $249 Save $70 Get Deal at Apple Why we like it The Apple Watch SE 3 is the best model if you're not looking to spend big bucks on an Apple Watch. We were expecting this model to drop to $199 during Black Friday, but it actually dropped to only $179. In testing, Mashable reporters have found it excels at both sleep tracking and cataloging key health metrics, without feeling like overkill. Even though this smartwatch is under $200, it still has an always-on display and all-day battery life, too. As of this writing, Amazon and Walmart have the lowest price on the Apple Watch SE 3, so take your pick. Best Apple Watch Ultra deals Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple Watch Ultra 4 (49mm, GPS + Cellular) $649.99 at Amazon $799 Save $149.01 Get Deal at Amazon Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple Watch Ultra 3 (49mm, GPS + Cellular) $549 at Best Buy $799 Save $250 Get Deal at Best Buy Why we picked this In looking for the best Black Friday Apple Watch deals, we found great savings on both the Apple Watch Ultra 3 and Ultra 4. Apple's Ultra watches are designed for rugged outdoor use and performance athletes. They have astounding battery life, lasting up to three days in low-power mode. They also offer both GPS and cellular connectivity. The older Apple Watch Ultra 3 , usually $799, is now $250 off at Best Buy, and we've never seen this previous-gen smartwatch priced so low. Over at Amazon, the Apple Watch Ultra 4 is now on sale for $649.99, a $149.01 discount from the list price. The newest Apple Ultra Watch has even better battery life and more advanced health tracking; like the mainstream Series 12, it offers improved heart rate sensors and a Readiness score. To be honest, the Ultra 3 offers a lot of the same features thanks to the recent watchOS 27 update, but if you want the more future-proofed option, then opt for the latest and greatest version, i.e., the Ultra 4. title: The best free Black Friday deals: How to get Kindle+, Audible, Apple Music, gift cards, and more at zero cost
summary: Some of the best Black Friday deals don't cost a thing. Here are the products and memberships that shoppers can get for free this holiday season.
content: The best free Black Friday deals: Best free gift card deal Buy a $100 gift card at Best Buy, get a bonus $15 gift card $100 Get Deal Best in-store freebie Lowe's Black Friday bucket giveaway Be one of the first 50 MyLowe's Rewards members in line Learn More Best BOGO deal Buy select power tools, get another cordless tool free Starting from $199 Get Deal Best free membership deal Amazon Prime 30-day free trial Get Deal Best free reading deal Kindle+ 30-day free trial Get Deal Best free music deal Apple Music 1-month free trial Get Deal Best free audiobook deal Audible 30-day free trial Get Deal Best streaming deal Apple TV 7-day free trial Get Deal Best free phone plan deal Verizon 30-day free trial Get Deal Best free fitness app deal Apple Fitness+ 1-month free trial Get Deal Black Friday sales are live, and while everyone loves a good discount, nothing beats an unexpected freebie — especially when you're buying gifts for other people. Of course, “free” usually comes with a few conditions. You might need to buy a certain product first, show up to a store, be a new subscriber, remember to cancel a plan by a certain date. Below, I've rounded up the best free Black Friday deals and trials that are worth the effort. Best free gift card deal Opens in a new window Credit: Best Buy Buy a $100 gift card at Best Buy, get a bonus $15 gift card $100 at Best Buy Get Deal at Best Buy Why we like it What's better than free money? Personally, I can't think of anything. Right now, anyone who buys select $100 Best Buy gift cards will earn a free $15 Best Buy voucher they can put toward a future purchase there. Choose from Regal, ChatGPT, Google Play , or Apple gift cards. Heads up: As part of the Apple Store's Black Friday Event , you'll soon be able to score a free gift card worth up to $300 there when you buy select Apple devices. The offer goes live on Friday, Nov. 27 and runs through Nov. 30. Best BOGO deal Opens in a new window Credit: Milwuakee Tool / The Home Depot Buy select power tools, get another cordless tool free Get Deal at The Home Depot Why we like it The Home Depot's BOGO Black Friday tool deal was a hit with Mashable readers last holiday season, so I'm pleased to report that it's back again . Just add certain on-sale cordless tools and kits to your cart to earn another free cordless tool worth up to $249 . You can take your pick from impact drivers, saws, hammer drills, sanders, and more from popular brands like DeWalt, Makita, Milwaukee, Ridgid, and Ryobi. Best in-store freebie deal Opens in a new window Credit: Lowe's Lowe's Black Friday bucket giveaway (Nov. 27) Learn More at Lowe's Why we like it Most of the best Black Friday deals are available online, so retailers have to pull out the stops to get people into their stores. And Lowe's is going hard with its free Black Friday Bucket giveaway for the second year in a row. Here's how it works: The first 50 MyLowe’s Rewards members in line at every store will receive a bucket containing at least 10 free products and offers. Four of those 50 buckets will include a red, green, gold, or silver ticket that earns their possessor a grand prize: either a free $2,000 major appliance, an EGO outdoor power tool, a Craftsman tools package, or a Blackstone grilling package. If you can't show up right away, fret not: The next 100 people in line will get a miniature bucket containing $5 in MyLowe’s Money and other rewards. The festivities kick off at 6 a.m. local time at more than 1,700 Lowe's stores. If you're not a MyLowe's Rewards member yet, you can sign up for free . More in-store freebie deals on Nov. 27 Bass Pro Shops and Cabela’s — The first 250 customers (ages 16 and older) at every store will receive a free mystery gift card worth $10 to $500, which will be valid from Dec. 6 to 24. JCPenney — Select stores are giving away four prizes throughout the day, including a miniature Harry Potter snow globe, a Ninja air fryer, diamond earrings, and a Samsonite suitcase. Michaels — Every store is giving away 500 "Countdown to Craftsmas" advent calendars. One calendar in every store contains a $100 gift card, and one recipient will win a $10,000 grand prize. Sephora at Kohl's — The first 200 customers at select stores will receive a free Kohl’s Cash voucher worth $5 to $100 to spend on beauty purchases that day. Target — The first 100 customers at every store will receive a free Target gift card worth $25, $50, or $100. One person per store will get a $1,000 gift card. Best free membership deal Opens in a new window Credit: Amazon Amazon Prime (30-day free trial) Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Paying for a membership just to shop a sale feels a little counterproductive. Luckily, eligible customers can try Amazon Prime free for 30 days. Starting your trial now gives you time to shop early deals and still have it for Black Friday and Cyber Monday . After the trial, Prime costs $14.99 per month or $139 per year, depending on your selected plan. Prime comes with more than free shipping, though that’s probably the perk you’ll use most while shopping for gifts. You also get Prime Video, Amazon Music’s ad-free listening options, access to a selection of books through Prime Reading, and member-exclusive deals. The newest addition is $0 delivery fees on eligible Uber Eats restaurant orders of $25 or more placed through Amazon — a useful extra for the nights you’d rather order dinner than make it. Best free reading deal Opens in a new window Credit: Amazon Kindle+ (30-day free trial) Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Books are one of those things I don’t particularly enjoy putting a spending limit on. A subscription at least gives you a way to read more without paying for every title separately. Kindle+, formerly Kindle Unlimited , offers a 30-day free trial with access to a catalog of ebooks, audiobooks, magazines, and comics. It automatically renews at $11.99 per month unless you cancel. You might also see an offer for two months for $0.99 total. That’s not free, but it’s worth comparing with the trial before you choose. Best free music deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Music Apple Music (1-month free trial) Get Deal at Apple Why we like it A music subscription is pretty easy to test for a month. You’ll have time to find your favorite artists, try a few playlists, and decide whether you like it enough to pay for it. New subscribers can get one month of Apple Music free, including ad-free listening and downloads for when you don’t have an internet connection. The Individual plan costs $11.99 per month afterward. And despite the name, you don’t need an iPhone to use it — Apple Music also works on Android and Windows. More free music deals Spotify Premium Individual — One month free for people who haven’t tried Premium before, then $12.99 per month. Includes ad-free music and offline downloads. Amazon Music Unlimited Individual — 30 days free for new subscribers, then $11.99 per month for Prime members or $12.99 per month for nonmembers, plus applicable tax. SoundCloud Go — 7 days free for new subscribers, then $4.99 per month, plus applicable tax. Subscription automatically renews unless cancelled. Deezer Family — One month free, then $19.99 per month. Cancel anytime. Best free audiobook deal Opens in a new window Credit: Amazon Audible (30-day free trial) Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it Not all reading has to involve sitting down with a book. Audible’s 30-day free trial lets new customers choose one audiobook from its collection, including bestsellers and new releases, and listen to an included catalog of podcasts. After the trial, it automatically renews at $8.99 per month unless you cancel. There’s also a separate promotion for three months at $0.99 per month, plus a $20 Audible bonus. I wouldn’t call that free, but paying $2.97 for three months might make more sense than taking one free month and then paying the regular rate. More free audiobook offers Hoopla — Free through participating public libraries. Check whether your library offers access before signing up; this is library borrowing, not a subscription trial that turns into a monthly bill. Kobo Plus Listen — 14 days free, then $7.99 per month. The Read & Listen plan includes both ebooks and audiobooks for $9.99 per month after the trial. You can use the Kobo Books app on your phone or tablet, so there’s no need to buy an e-reader. Everand — 30 days free, with plans starting at $11.99 per month afterward. The trial includes one premium-title unlock, plus unlimited access to a separate catalog of more than 20,000 audiobooks, ebooks, and podcasts. All You Can Books — 30 days free, then $24.99 per month. The service advertises unlimited downloads from its catalog of audiobooks, ebooks, language courses, and other content, and says downloaded files remain yours even after cancellation. Best free magazine and news deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple News+ (1-month free trial) Get Deal at Apple Why we like it Apple News+ gives new subscribers one month to try its collection of newspapers and magazines, making it a different option from the book-focused subscriptions above. The subscription costs $12.99 per month after the trial. I’d use the free month to check whether the publications you actually want to read are included. A long list of magazines sounds nice, but it doesn’t mean much if you’re only opening one of them. Best free streaming deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Get a 7 day trial of Apple TV Get Deal at Apple Why we like it If you've had an Apple original on your watchlist, Apple TV's free trial is a good excuse to finally get around to watching it. New subscribers can try the streaming service free for seven days, giving you access to hundreds of exclusive shows and movies, with new releases added every week. After the trial, the subscription costs $14.99 per month, so it's worth setting a reminder to cancel if you don't plan on keeping it. More free streaming deals YouTube Premium — One month free for eligible new subscribers, then $15.99 per month for the Individual plan, $26.99 per month for Family, or $8.99 per month for eligible students. Includes ad-free YouTube and YouTube Music, offline downloads, and background playback. Automatically renews unless canceled. AMC+ — 7 days free for eligible new subscribers, then $7.99 per month with ads or $10.99 per month for the ad-free Premium plan. An annual Premium subscription costs $109.99. Hulu + Live TV — 3 days free for eligible subscribers, then $99.99 per month unless canceled. Includes Hulu and Disney+ with ads, ESPN, more than 100 live TV channels, and unlimited DVR. Best free phone plan deal Opens in a new window Credit: Verizon Try Verizon free for 30 days Get Deal at Verizon Why we like it If you've been thinking about switching phone providers, Verizon is also offering a 30-day free trial, giving you a chance to test its network without switching providers. You can keep your existing phone number and continue using your current network while trying Verizon through an eSIM. There's no credit card required, no contract, and no need to remember to cancel, either. The trial automatically expires after 30 days, so you won't be charged if you decide not to switch. More free phone plan deals T-Mobile — 30 days free for eligible non-T-Mobile customers with a compatible, unlocked device. Includes access to T-Mobile's network, satellite coverage, and member benefits, with no credit card, credit check, or commitment required. Visible — 15 days free with unlimited data, talk, text, and hotspot access on Verizon's network. No credit card, contract, or automatic renewal required. AT&T Wireless — 30 days free with unlimited talk and text, plus 100GB of data. Keep your current phone, number, and service while testing the network. Compatible iPhone or Android required. Best free fitness app deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Get one month of Apple Fitness+ for free Get Deal at Apple Why we like it If you're planning to get a head start on your New Year's fitness goals, Apple Fitness+ is offering new subscribers one month free. The service gives you access to a range of guided workouts, from strength training and HIIT to yoga, Pilates, and meditation, so there's plenty to try before deciding whether it's worth paying for. After the trial, it costs $9.99 per month or $79.99 per year. And if you're planning to pick up a new Apple device during the Black Friday sales , you could get an even better deal, with three months free when you purchase an eligible device. More free fitness app deals Glo — 7 days free, with access to more than 12,000 on-demand yoga, Pilates, meditation, and strength classes led by over 60 instructors. Peloton App — Free trial for new members, with access to thousands of workout classes across more than 15 exercise types, including options that don't require equipment. Cancel anytime. Ladder — 7 days free, with access to all training plans, personalized workout recommendations, introductory classes, and fitness communities. No payment information required to start the trial. Nike Training Club — Completely free, with access to guided workouts, multi-week training programs, and fitness advice. No subscription or trial period required. Best free meditation and mindfulness deal Opens in a new window Credit: Calm Get a 7 day free trial of Calm Get Deal at Calm Why we like it If you're looking for a way to unwind after a busy day, Calm is offering a seven-day free trial of its Premium membership. You'll get access to more than 50,000 minutes of content, including guided meditations, Sleep Stories, relaxing music, and nature sounds. After the trial, the subscription automatically renews at $79.99 per year, plus applicable taxes, so make sure you cancel before the seven days are up if you don't want to continue.

I’ve tried hair removal creams, wax strips, the fanciest razors money could buy, and, most recently, IPL (intense pulsed light) devices. And despite my best efforts to find one thing that does it all, keeping my skin smooth and hairless takes a combination of tools. Apparently, this is a group project. It’s also an expensive one. Between replacing razors and buying a device that promises less shaving in the future, the cost of grooming adds up. Throw in the pink tax, and I’d rather wait for a sale than pay full price for the privilege of removing hair I didn’t ask for. Luckily, Amazon has been dropping Black Friday deals since Nov. 19, so there’s no need to wait until after Thanksgiving to see what’s on sale. Whether you’re trying to get ahead of ingrown hairs, keep a beard in check, or finally commit to IPL, these are the best Black Friday grooming deals to shop right now. content: Best Black Friday headphones deals at a glance: Best headphones deal overall Bose QuietComfort Ultra (1st gen) $229 (save $200) Get Deal Best budge pick Sony WH-CH530 $38 (save $31.99) Get Deal Best premium deal Sony WH-1000XM6 $348 (save $111.99) Get Deal Another great option under $200 Sony WH-1000XM4C $198 (Save $101.99) Get Deal Some Black Friday headphones deals have already started out strong, but with the official start of Amazon's Black Friday sale, they're even better. Take, for instance, the 45% discount on the second-generation Bose QuietComfort headphones ( released just this past August, btw ). Prefer a flagship model? No problem, the Sony WH-1000XM6 — our top pick for premium sound — are over $100 off . SEE ALSO: Everything to know about Black Friday 2026: Best deals, sale dates, how to shop smart, and more As someone who tests headphones year-round and is heading into her sixth year covering Black Friday at Mashable, I only write about deals that are actual deals. That means double-checking accurate list prices, using my price history knowledge from looking at headphone product listings every time I open my work laptop, and consulting the Mashable shopping team's collective knowledge of historical pricing. This year, my criteria also include an awareness of price increases that have affected nearly every area of tech. With all that in mind, those two aforementioned deals — and the ones below — are the best headphones deals you'll find ahead of Black Friday. And when more inevitably crop up as the shopping holiday draws closer, you'll be sure to find them on this list. Best Black Friday headphones deal overall Opens in a new window Credit: Bose Bose QuietComfort Ultra (1st gen) $229 at Woot $429 Save $200 Get Deal at Woot Why we like it It's basically impossible to beat the value of this Bose deal, which brings the first-generation Ultras down to a record-low price of $229. Not only is that a $200 markdown — it's $120 cheaper than the next-gen Ultras, which have minimal differences from the first-gen option. In other words, if you're looking for flagship performance at mid-range prices, this is the deal to get. Best Black Friday budget headphones deal Sony WH-CH530 $38 at Amazon $69.99 Save $31.99 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it You don’t have to spend Bose money for a pair of everyday headphones. At $38, the Sony WH-CH530 offer up to 55 hours of battery life, multipoint Bluetooth for connecting to two devices at once, and a quick-charge feature that gets you another 90 minutes of listening after just three minutes plugged in. These are on-ear headphones, and they don’t have active noise cancellation, so they’re better suited to shoppers who want an inexpensive pair for music and taking calls. These headphones also hit the market just this past September , and at $38, are already matching the record-low of their predecessor and a former budget favorite of ours, the Sony CH-520N . Best Black Friday premium headphones deal Sony WH-1000XM6 $348 at Amazon $459.99 Save $111.99 Get Deal at Amazon Get Deal at Sony Why we like it The Sony WH-1000XM6 are our top pick for premium sound , and the discount makes their flagship price a little easier to stomach. Mashable’s testing found improved sound quality, particularly on vocal-heavy tracks, along with excellent active noise cancellation and a comfortable fit for longer listening sessions. Sony also brought back the folding design, so these are easier to pack than the XM5s. Battery life hasn’t improved from the previous generation, but you still get up to 30 hours with ANC on. Between Apple's summer price hikes on the MacBook Air and MacBook Neo, and its expensive new "Pro" releases this fall, these holiday savings are a sight for sore eyes — and bank accounts. Then there's the budget MacBook Neo, which is $100 off right now in every color — its biggest discount yet. title: The best Black Friday power station deals you can shop today

content: Best Black Friday portable power station deals at a glance: Best Anker deal Anker Solix C1000 Gen 2 $469.99 (save $329.01) Get Deal Best Bluetti deal Bluetti Elite 10 Mini $139 (save $60) Get Deal Best DJI deal DJI Power 1000 V2 $379.99 (save $40) Get Deal Best Jackery deal Jackery FridgeGuard + expansion battery $1,099 (save $260) Get Deal Best EcoFlow deal EcoFlow Titan 5000 $2,199 (save $1,100) Get Deal Black Friday sales are live, and while a portable power station won’t fix, well, gestures at everything , it can at least keep your phone charged when the lights go out. Portable power stations have been in high demand this year, so it's well worth shopping sale models during Black Friday. SEE ALSO: Black Friday 2026: Opening times for Walmart, Target, Best Buy, and more Below, you’ll find the best Black Friday power station deals we’ve spotted so far, including Mashable-tested favorites from Anker, Bluetti, EcoFlow, and DJI. Best Anker deal Opens in a new window Credit: Anker Anker Solix C1000 Gen 2 $469.99 at Amazon $799 Save $329.01 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it The Anker Solix C1000 Gen 2 is a Mashable fave, and for good reason. Our power station expert, Lauren Allain, gave it 4.5 stars and a Mashable Choice Award after spending two weeks using it to charge her devices and run appliances, including a rice cooker, blender, and air fryer. It weighs just under 25 pounds and can fully recharge in 49 minutes. (You’ll need to turn on UltraFast charging in the Anker app to get that speed.) You can’t add an expansion battery, so make sure its 1,024Wh capacity works for you. But for weekend camping trips or occasional power outages, it has a lot to offer. And if you missed it during October Prime Day, you’re getting another shot at the same price. The Anker Solix C1000 Gen 2 is on sale for $469.99, down from $799, at Amazon. That’s a 41% discount, or $329.01 in savings. Read our review of the Anker Solix C1000 Gen 2. If you’re mostly trying to keep your phone charged while you’re out and about, Allain says the Bluetti Elite 10 Mini is her “go-to” for quick trips off-grid. It weighs just four pounds, has a built-in handle, and can recharge your phone about six times. You get an AC outlet, two USB-C ports, and two USB-A ports, too, though the 128Wh battery is better suited to small devices than power-hungry appliances. Right now, you can get the Bluetti Elite 10 Mini for $139 at Amazon, down from $199. That’s $60 off, or a 30% discount. Another great Bluetti deal Opens in a new window Credit: Bluetti Bluetti Elite 100 mini $399.99 $799 Save $399.01 Get Deal Why we like it Take a quick glance at portable power stations, and you'll see they're black or gray boxes. Occasionally we get a nice white model, but Bluetti is the only brand that makes portable power look kinda cute. That's why we're highlighting the Bluetti Elite 100 mini . In addition to its sale price of $399, down from $799, we're very into the pink option. After all, who wouldn't like a bit of fun color during a power outage? Its dedicated ports can fast-charge compatible DJI drone batteries, but you’ll need to buy the cable separately. It’s super quiet, so you’re not adding a bunch of fan noise to whatever you’re filming. And with four AC outlets, two USB-C ports, and two USB-A ports, there’s room for the rest of your gear. A full recharge from a wall outlet takes 56 minutes; solar charging requires a separate DJI adapter. Right now, you can get it for $379.99, down from $419.99, at Amazon. Groceries are expensive these days, and power outages tend to always happen right after a giant Costco haul. The Jackery FridgeGuard with an expansion battery is on sale at Amazon for $260 off. Together, you'll have 2.048Wh to keep your fridge cooling for up to three hours, according to Jackery's numbers. Unlike the standard design of most portable power stations, the Jackery FridgeGuard has a slim design, measuring 2.6 inches, so it can sit on top of your fridge, nearly invisible. Best EcoFlow deal Opens in a new window Credit: EcoFlow EcoFlow Titan 5000 $2,199 $3,299 Save $1,100 Get Deal Why we like it Maybe we're stretching the "portable" aspect of portable power stations, but if you need more than a weekend of backup power, the EcoFlow Titan 5000 is worth the investment. title: Black Friday PS5 and PS5 Pro deals: See the best deals at Amazon, Best Buy, Target and Walmart
summary: Hunting for Black Friday PS5 deals at Amazon, Best Buy, Walmart, and Target? Brand-new discounts are scarce, so we rounded up the best refurbished and bundle PS5 and PS5 Pro options in stock.
content: Where to find PS5 and PS5 Pro deals right now: Best PS5 Deal at Amazon PlayStation 5 (Digital Edition) $599 Get Deal Best PS5 Deal at Best Buy PlayStation 5 (Digital Edition) $599 Get Deal Best PS5 Deal at Target PlayStation 5 (Digital Edition) $599 Get Deal Best PS5 Deal at Walmart PlayStation 5 (Digital Edition) $599 Get Deal Best PS5 Pro Deal at Amazon PlayStation 5 Pro $899.99 Get Deal Best PS5 Pro Deal at Best Buy PlayStation 5 Pro $899.99 Get Deal Best PS5 Pro Deal at Target PlayStation 5 Pro $899.99 Get Deal If you are trying to get your hands on a PlayStation 5 right now, the real win is not a discount — it is simply finding one in stock at standard retail price. Between a global RAM shortage driven by the AI boom, which pushed Sony to hike console prices twice in under a year, and the massive hype around GTA 6 , standalone console markdowns are nowhere to be found. Today, the PS5 Slim Digital Edition starts at $599.99, and the flagship PS5 Pro retails for $899.99. Depending on the model, that means PlayStation 5 hardware actually costs $150 to $200 more today than it did when the console originally launched in 2020. For weeks, the hype around GTA 6 completely wiped out store shelves across the country — especially for the PS5 Pro . The good news is that major retailers like Walmart, Best Buy, Target, and Amazon are finally restocking standard PS5 models at regular list price. We recommend paying full sticker price, because third-party marketplace listings are barely worth looking at anyway — the few that are up are mostly refurbished units marked up to nearly double the retail cost, so we left them off our list. PS5 vs. PS5 Pro — which restock should you grab? Even at full sticker price, picking up a PS5 or PS5 Pro makes a lot of sense if you are upgrading for GTA 6 or catching up on Sony's massive library of current-gen games. The standard PlayStation 5 Digital Edition gives you the core current-gen experience in a slim, compact design that fits easily into a media console. You get an 825GB ultra-high-speed SSD that cuts load screens to seconds, 4K TV output, up to 120 fps gameplay on supported titles, and Tempest 3D AudioTech. It also ships with Sony's DualSense wireless controller — featuring haptic feedback and adaptive triggers that add physical resistance when you pull a trigger or drive over rough terrain — and plays more than 8,500 backward-compatible PS4 games with smoother frame rates. Plus, if you ever decide you want to buy physical discs later, you can snap Sony's detachable disc drive right onto the side. SEE ALSO: 'GTA 6' players on PS5: Update your consoles now to avoid delays If you want the best possible visuals in Vice City, stepping up to the PlayStation 5 Pro unlocks PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) for sharper AI-upscaled clarity, upgraded GPU performance, and advanced ray tracing. While Rockstar confirmed GTA 6 targets 30 fps across all consoles at launch, the PS5 Pro is the only system that gets exclusive ray-traced shadows and cleaner image upscaling in the game. Beyond GTA 6 , dozens of major PS5 titles run at higher frame rates and sharper resolutions on the Pro, and its massive 2TB SSD easily swallows GTA 6 's 212GB install size with plenty of storage left over for the rest of your library. Where to find the PS5 and PS5 Pro right now If you want to lock down a console while shelves still have stock, here is where the PS5 Digital Edition and PS5 Pro are currently available at standard retail price: Amazon — Along with the standalone PlayStation 5 Digital Edition and PlayStation 5 Pro 2TB available at regular retail price, Amazon also has the PlayStation 5 Digital Edition (825GB) + DualSense Wireless Controller Bundle discounted by roughly $22 — the only actual bundle discount floating around major stores right now. Best Buy — Both the PlayStation 5 Digital Edition and the PlayStation 5 Pro 2TB are available to order online right now at list price. Target — You can grab both the PlayStation 5 Digital Edition and the PlayStation 5 Pro 2TB at standard retail price while current restocks last. Walmart — The PlayStation 5 Digital Edition is back in stock directly from Walmart at regular retail price. Where to actually save on PS5 hardware If you don't want to pay 2026's inflated brand-new sticker prices, look straight at PlayStation Direct's certified refurbished lineup . Sony sells official refurbished PS5 and PS5 Pro consoles for up to $100 less than brand-new units ($499.99 for the Digital Edition, $549.99 for the Disc Edition, and $849 for the PS5 Pro), backed by a full one-year manufacturer's warranty. It is the most reliable way to shave real money off the console without gambling on sketchy third-party resellers. You might also spot occasional game bundles at big-box stores, though availability is hit-or-miss. Even the overpriced bundles and double-the-price third-party listings floating around online are largely sold out, proving just how intense the demand still is. Opens in a new window Credit: PlayStation PlayStation 5 (Certified Refurbished) Shop Now at PlayStation Direct After watching store shelves sit completely empty less than a week ago, seeing major retailers finally restock both the PS5 and PS5 Pro is a welcome surprise. If you are trying to jump into GTA 6 without paying double to a reseller, grab an official unit at retail price — or check PlayStation Direct's refurbished store — before this wave clears out too.

It just wouldn’t make sense to buy one without that feature, given that the whole point is to make vacuuming as hands-off as possible. I have two beagles, and I vacuum twice a day. That’s why I have what I like to call my Dreame Team: the Dreame L60 Pro Ultra , the Aero Pro Steam , and the N20 Steam Portable Carpet Cleaner . I also have a lone Shark upright. Clearly, I have enough cleaning to do without emptying a robot’s dustbin, too. SEE ALSO: We found the best robot vacuums for every floor, budget, and level of laziness Luckily, almost every robot vacuum at Amazon seems to be on sale for Black Friday , and Mashable has tested so many robot vacuums . But when everything has a flashing red "Black Friday deal" label, figuring out which deals are genuinely good takes a little more work. That’s what Mashable's shopping team is here for. Throughout Black Friday, I’ll be double-checking MSRPs, comparing prices across retailers, and watching for new deals from our favorite robot vacuum brands. As always, Mashable is here to get you the best value for your money this holiday season. So, without further ado, here are our picks for the best Black Friday self-emptying robot vacuum deals. Our budget pick Opens in a new window Credit: Roborock Roborock Q10 S5+ $229.99 $549.99 Save $320 Get Deal Why we like it The Roborock Q10 S5+ is a Mashable fave. Not only is it an affordable option, but Leah Stodart, our former vacuum expert, found it reliably performed in her cleaning tests , including wiping up a variety of spills and splatters in her kitchen. It’s also super quiet, even when emptying its dustbin. Stodart liked its accurate mapping and sonic mopping, which actually scrubs rather than just dragging a damp pad across your floors. At $229.99, you’re getting more than a basic robot that picks up crumbs and calls it a day. The only downside? You'll have to wash the mop pad yourself, and Stodart noted that it gets dirty quickly. It also isn’t the most thorough around edges. But if you want a self-emptying robot vacuum without spending $500 or more, this is a good entry-level pick. Our mid-range pick Opens in a new window Credit: Roborock Roborock Qrevo S Pro $379.99 at Amazon $699.99 Save $320 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it If washing the mop pads yourself is a dealbreaker, the Roborock Qrevo S Pro is on sale for $379.99, down from $699.99. That’s $150 more than the Q10 S5+, but you’re getting a dock that does more than empty the dustbin. It also washes the mop pads with hot water, dries them with warm air, and refills the robot’s water tank. That may feel like an unnecessary feature, but after testing a lot of robot vacuum and mop combos, we can tell you firsthand that mildewy robot mop pads really stink. And on a personal level, if I’m buying a robot to mop my floors, I’d prefer not to be responsible for washing its dirty pads afterward. Best self-emptying robot vacuum and mop splurge Opens in a new window Credit: Dreame Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete $989.99 at Amazon $1,699.99 Save $710 Get Deal at Amazon Why we like it If you're going to splurge on a robot vacuum, make it the Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete. Its 35,000 suction power is only topped by Roborock's Saros 20 line, but Stodart found the Dreame to be "much more of a beast" than the basic Saros 20. And while we haven't tested the Saros 20 Sonic yet, it would cost you an extra $360 . So the Dreame X60 it is! Besides its impressive suction power, it also features a livestream pet camera, dual spinning mopping pads that are more precise around edges than flat mops or roller mops, and a design that is just over three inches tall. If you have low-clearance furniture, it should glide underneath without issue. Read our full review of the Dreame X60 Max Ultra Complete . More Black Friday deals on self-emptying robot vacuums We couldn't limit ourselves to just three Black Friday deals on robot vacuums , especially when some of our favorite vacuums are currently on sale. The Eufy C28 is a particular favorite of ours for its reasonable price tag and well-balanced features, and it's currently more than 50% off as part of Amazon's Black Friday sale. The Narwal Flow 2 is another crowdpleaser, and the Narwal line generally mops and navigates better than the competition. According to PCMag (also owned by Ziff Davis), the 4K picture is perfectly clear at multiple angles, though the color spectrum is slightly lacking and the 60Hz refresh rate probably counts this out for gamers. It's a specific kind of product, but if you're the intended audience, a $215 discount is pretty sweet. If you're looking for a bedroom or kitchen TV, you can pick up this 1080p LED TV for under $100 at Amazon right now. Opens in a new window Credit: Insignia Insignia 40-inch F40 Series LED HD Smart Fire TV $84.98 at Amazon $149.99 Save $65.01 Get Deal at Amazon onn 32-inch LCD HD Smart TV If $100 is still a bit rich for your budget, then head to Walmart for this doorbuster TV deal. If you haven't heard of onn before, it's Walmart's own electronics brand, and this 32-inch smart TV is powered by the Vizio OS. If you need to buy a bunch of TVs for a rental property, a kid's bedroom, or a guest room, you can get this LCD model for just $68. Opens in a new window Credit: onn vizio tv onn 32-inch LCD HD Smart TV $68 at Walmart $88 Save $20 Get Deal at Walmart Vizio 50-inch Mini LED 4K QLED Smart TV One of the best balances between budget and quality you'll find this Black Friday is in the Vizio 50-inch VQM50C TV. Mashable's sister site CNET (also owned by Ziff Davis) named it the best budget TV of 2026 . (PCMag also named it a budget favorite ). Why? The stand is complicated to attach, but if you can get over that, you get a gorgeous 50-inch picture for less than $200. You want it big enough to be enjoyable to actually use, but not so big that it dominates the entire room. An art TV seems like the fix to keep design in mind (i.e., not having an ugly black box on the wall), but that can be a bigger investment for what's most folks' secondary TV. That's why former Mashable Senior Shopping Reporter Leah Stodart loved the Hisense H5 Deco TV and used it in her own bedroom . She wrote the TV "matches my room's color scheme and level of whimsy," both of which are crucial for maintaining a great vibe in your space. That doesn't mean you sacrifice on quality. At $299.99, you'll be hard-pressed to find another TV that meshes this picture quality with an aesthetically pleasing design. For now, you can grab it on sale both at Amazon and Best Buy . Secondly, Hisense may have a smaller art library than Samsung's expansive one, but it also requires no additional subscription to use . The same, unfortunately, can not be said for Samsung. In other words, if you prefer to buy your product up front and have it perform to its fullest ability without an additional monthly payment, you'd likely prefer the Hisense TV. Unfortunately, even with an $1,100 price drop at Best Buy, this flagship OLED TV still requires a hefty investment. What makes this TV so special? It takes everything we loved about Samsung's famous The Frame Art TVs and brings them into a flagship OLED TV. The S95H borrows the matte, anti-glare display that made The Frame so legendary, as well as the ultra-thin design that almost disappears onto your living room wall. Crucially, it also has Art Mode, letting it double as an art TV when not in use. We're not done. This TV can also support up to 8 HDMI devices at once, wirelessly. And with a peak refresh rate of up to 165Hz, video games and movies have never looked better. It's truly a drool-worthy TV. title: I found 36 of the best Black Friday phone deals on iPhones, Samsung Galaxy, Google Pixel, and more
summary: The best Black Friday phone deals save shoppers up to $600 on unlocked Apple, Google Pixel, Samsung Galaxy, Motorola, and Nothing devices.
content: The best Black Friday phone deals: Best unlocked iPhone deal Apple iPhone Air (256GB) $799.99 (save $300) Get Deal Best unlocked Samsung Galaxy phone deal Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 (256GB) $1,549.99 (save $350) Get Deal Best unlocked Google Pixel phone deal Google Pixel 11 Pro (256GB) $749 (save $350) Get Deal Best unlocked Motorola phone deal Motorola Razr Ultra 2025 (512GB) $699.99 (save $600) Get Deal Best unlocked Nothing phone deal Nothing Phone (4a) Pro (128GB) $397.99 (save $102) Get Deal This holiday season, the best Black Friday phone deals help offset the price hikes that have affected almost every brand. A new phone is more expensive these days, but it's easy to avoid paying full price if you shop strategically. In fact, you might pay as little as $0 by upgrading through your carrier. The only catch is that their deals typically require a trade-in and a lock-in to an extended contract. For a new phone with no strings attached, go the unlocked route instead. Retailers like Amazon and Best Buy are currently discounting unlocked smartphones from Apple, Samsung, Google, Motorola, and Nothing during their Black Friday sales . After spending a few hours combing through their deals, I've identified three dozen good ones that can save you up to $600. Whether you want a new phone that takes incredible pictures, offers multi-day battery life, flips, folds, or comes in well under $500, you've got plenty of options. Best iPhone deal Opens in a new window Credit: Apple Apple iPhone Air (256GB) $799.99 at Best Buy $1,099.99 Save $300 Get Deal at Best Buy The ultra-thin iPhone Air is the best choice "for minimalists and aesthetes who care more about their phone's looks than its performance," to quote my iPhone buying guide . It's not the fastest or longest-lasting iPhone, nor does it have the best cameras, but it is a gorgeous phone. (Mashable's Senior Editor Stan Schroeder called it "the sexiest iPhone I've ever tested.") Thanks to Best Buy, the base model now costs $100 less than the standard iPhone 17 ; it's usually $200 more. Note that the iPhone Air's MagSafe Battery pack is also on sale for 40% off this Black Friday. Read Mashable's full review of the Apple iPhone Air. Tech Editor Timothy Beck Werth really liked its thin passport-style design, which features two bright and beautiful AMOLED displays and a near-invisible crease. He was also impressed by its powerful Snapdragon chipset. Its "50MP wide and 50MP ultrawide cameras are fine, but not elite," he noted, but that's frequently the case with foldables. (Creators and mobile photographers should look into the Galaxy S26 Ultra instead — or the Google Pixel 11 Pro, below.) Based on my research, Amazon's Black Friday price of $1,549.99 for the base Galaxy Z Fold 8 is an all-time low. Read Mashable's full review of the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8. It's equipped with 50MP main, 48MP ultra-wide, and 48MP telephoto lenses; its digital zoom maxes out at an impressive 120x; and its Magic Capture feature does a great job of grabbing still photos from videos. This "combination of hardware and software makes your images consistently look nice, even in challenging lighting conditions," said Tech Reporter Alex Perry. The Pixel 11 Pro usually costs $300 more than the vanilla Pixel 11 , but when you factor in their Black Friday discounts, it's now just a $60-ish upcharge.
